export.description: Specifies if declaring module exports the pipe.

flat.description: Flag to indicate if a dir is created.

module.description: Allows specification of the declaring module.

path.description: The path to create the pipe.

skipImport.description: Allows for skipping the module import.

spec.description: Specifies if a spec file is generated.

description:
I’m setting up a new Angular pipe for the **my‑app** project. The pipe will be named **my‑pipe** and placed in the **./src/app/pipes** directory, using a flat folder structure so no additional sub‑directory is created. It will belong to the **app.module.ts** module, and I intend to have the Angular CLI add the necessary import automatically (i.e., not skipping the import). The pipe will not be exported from its declaring module.

A spec file should also be generated for the pipe, and the overall configuration retains the default behavior of not exporting the pipe itself. Let me know if any adjustments are needed.
